caption: A distant lightning bolt strikes the sea far out from a cliff, so small in the distance that it is over before the eye can follow it.

sa.check: A cliff with the sea stretching out from it.
A lightning bolt strikes the sea far out.
The bolt is small and distant.
The bolt is brief: it is over almost as soon as it appears.
The bolt strikes the sea, not the cliff or the shore.

pc.expect: The bolt and its flash are brief and gone; the sea around it is lit only during the flash and returns to dark.
pc.fail: The bolt stands as a steady lit line for the rest of the clip; or the sea keeps glowing where it struck; or the bolt fades in slowly; or the sky stays lit after the bolt is gone.

pc.expect: The cliff, the shore and the sea are the same across dark and lit frames; the flash reveals what was there.
pc.fail: Boats or rocks appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or the cliff changes shape; or a glowing pillar stands on the sea after the flash; or a second bolt hangs frozen in the sky.

pc.expect: The bolt is a thin jagged line from cloud to sea, small with distance.
pc.fail: The bolt is a perfectly straight beam; or a smooth curve; or a wide glowing tube out of scale with its distance; or a bolt that hangs in mid-air touching neither cloud nor sea.

pc.expect: The flash lights the far sea and the cloud undersides around the bolt during the strike; the cliff and near shore brighten less or not at all.
pc.fail: The bolt is visible while the far sea and clouds stay as dark as before; or the near cliff lights up as brightly as the strike point; or the sea is lit while no bolt is present.

pc.expect: The sea stays water and the cliff stays rock; nothing passes through either.
pc.fail: The bolt continues below the sea surface as a lit line under the water; or the cliff becomes transparent; or the cliff face splits or moves; or the sea turns into solid ground.

pc.expect: The sea, the cliff and the sky keep their colours apart from the flash.
pc.fail: The sea changes colour permanently; or the cliff changes colour; or the sky turns to daylight after the flash.
